name: YogaNow – Iyengar Yoga
reason: Health restore re-check (12 Nov 2026): the health rule no longer blocks it (its own site, yoganow-basel.ch, frames Iyengar yoga as prevention and support for physical complaints; the 60-minute yoga-therapy session would simply be left out), but it still fails on scope and thinness. It is a one-teacher studio (Luis Gonzalez, Iyengar Level 1) with no teacher training, so it does not meet the yoga-school brief; the site has only three real pages (home, prices, about Iyengar yoga), still carries lorem-ipsum and hair-salon placeholder text, gives no workshop programme, and its photos sit on cdn-website.com hosts (de.cdn-website.com refused our robots.txt with a 403). As an individual listing for Luis Gonzalez there would be two items at most (weekly classes and a Jyotish astrology reading, both on the home page URL). Contact info@yoganow-basel.ch exists.
